author: K. L. Pryor
title: Grade 6 students lead math MCA participation at Lanesboro Elementary for 2024-25
text:
Sixth-grade students recorded the highest math participation rate for the 2024-25 MCA at Lanesboro Elementary School, Minnesota Department of Education data shows. Minnesota Department of Education
Of the 130 students who participated in the math section at Lanesboro Elementary, 22 were sixth-graders.
Based on the exam’s benchmarks, 41% of sixth-grade participants reached proficiency in mathematics.
The MCA and Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are statewide exams evaluating students on Minnesota’s academic standards and meeting federal and state requirements. The tests measure math, reading, and science at relevant grade levels. Most students take the MCA, although students with special education eligibility may instead complete the Alt MCA.
Overall student proficiency on Minnesota’s MCA assessments has decreased compared to before the pandemic , as reported in Minnesota’s Report Card. Mathematics proficiency fell more than 7% from 2019, while reading proficiency declined by nearly 5%.
